meta.title: x/tools/gopls: didChangeConfiguration ignores the new configuration
meta.fix_ref: golang/tools@97363e29fc9b (internal/lsp: handle staticcheck in didChangeConfiguration; CL 254038, 'Fixes golang/go#41311'), cherry-picked to gopls-release-branch.0.5 as 796b347e00 (CL 254427)
meta.build_notes: Both built with the local Go (go1.27.1) through a wrapper module (their go.mod replaces x/tools); the server runs the local go command. The reporter used v0.5.0-pre1; the fix merged 2020-09-13 and was cherry-picked to the 0.5 release branch; v0.4.4 was tagged 2020-07-29, v0.5.0 2020-09-14.
meta.notes: The staticcheck analyzers were added to the options only when the view was created; enabling staticcheck later through workspace/didChangeConfiguration (and the configuration the server then fetches) changed the flag but not the analyzer set, so no staticcheck diagnostics appeared. The reporter's own client additionally did not answer workspace/configuration (a client bug found in the thread); the maintainer confirmed the gopls bug with VS Code, which answers it, as this harness does.

settings_note: The session starts with the defaults (staticcheck off); the ops turn staticcheck on with workspace/didChangeConfiguration, and the fresh sessions start with the settings the ops leave behind (staticcheck on).

files.note: the go.mod of the fix's regression test TestChangeConfiguration (gopls/internal/regtest/configuration_test.go at 97363e29); the issue gives no code
the file a/a.go of the fix's regression test TestChangeConfiguration: a doc comment that a staticcheck (stylecheck) analyzer reports at line 2 once staticcheck is enabled

repro.steps: Open a/a.go (no diagnostics with the default settings). Enable staticcheck through workspace/didChangeConfiguration (settings gopls.staticcheck = true; the server then fetches the configuration). Reported: the new configuration is ignored and no staticcheck diagnostics appear. Probe: the diagnostics of a/a.go are compared with a fresh session started with staticcheck enabled, and a fresh control. (The set_config op names a/a.go only because case_format.py requires an existing path for every op; the notification is workspace-wide.)

attempts.summary: Run 2026-09-23T09:17 (this case revision): not-reproduced-pre, but for a toolchain reason, not because the bug is absent: every session on both builds answered no diagnostics for a/a.go, including the fresh sessions that start with staticcheck enabled. The session logs show why: gopls v0.4.4/v0.5.0 built and run with go1.27 report 'analyses failed: analysis atomicalign for package mod.com/a panicked: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference', so no analysis diagnostics (vet or staticcheck) are produced at all. The era Go (1.14/1.15) has no darwin/arm64 release, and rebuilding v0.4.4 with go1.16 would change the build shared with gopls-38424. Pre-check 4 (the era toolchain runs here and the build works with it) fails for analysis-based bugs of gopls v0.4-v0.5; no second attempt.
